a: nebulaStyle counts a ramp nebula against weaselTheme, not the lab's theme, so a ramp only the lab's theme declares throws
Every floating panel is pinned to the same top-right corner, so a second one covers the first entirely
Toggling `reorderable` on a Workspace remounts every tile, trials and their state included
`onReorder` hands back tile-panel node ids (`lk-panel-<key>`), and a trial id with that prefix renders as an empty panel
b: Uninstalling one `useLabAmbient` caller removes every caller that installed the same array
A presenting lab blanks the host page's root and body background and resets its color-scheme even when it is not in an iframe
`presentation.enter()` in a lab with no focused trial hides the lab's chrome and presents nothing
